title: New Puppy Guide Beginner FAQ

body:
Q: How often do puppies pee?
A: Every 1-2 hours; after waking, eating, playing.

Q: When can we walk outside?
A: After vet clears - usually post 2nd vaccine round, carried before.

Q: Nipping?
A: Yelp, redirect to toy, end play briefly.
